correctness.rationale: Each allowed matrix is uniquely determined by three independent cross blocks. Rank-normal form for the first cross block, followed by two alternating Schur eliminations, gives half-rank r+s+t. The q^(2rs) lift factor and symplectic pullback H are proved by direct kernel restriction and counting image radicals/quotient symplectic subspaces; no finite computation substitutes for that proof. The class-two orbit-method count for odd q is O’Brien–Voll Theorem A. The packaged verifier exhaustively checks 12 small prime-field and three F4 rank histograms plus small pullback cases.

value.rationale: Complex character-degree multiplicities are natural, nontrivial invariants of complete tripartite class-two groups. The formula determines all degrees for an infinite three-parameter family, including K_{3,3,3}, beyond any one-/two-universal-vertex recurrence; the symplectic-image radical analysis explains the rank-stratification mechanism and makes calculations possible without enumerating q^(ab+ac+bc) edge weights.
